meta.promptText: Dark spots aur dull skin ke liye India mein konsa vitamin C serum kharidun?

response.text:
Haan — **dark spots + dull skin** ke liye India mein meri first choice **10% Vitamin C** serum hogi, especially agar aap beginner hain. Stable Vitamin C derivatives 10–15% range mein generally practical aur less-irritating option hote hain. [www.dotandkey.com](https://www.dotandkey.com/blogs/skin-care/dermatologist-recommended-face-serums-in-india?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### 🍊 Meri top picks

### [Minimalist Vitamin C 10% Face Serum]()
*₹284*

### [Deconstruct 10% Vitamin C + Ferulic Acid Serum]()
*₹458*

### [Dot & Key 10% Vitamin C + E + Niacinamide Serum]()
*₹278*

### [Plum 15% Vitamin C Face Serum]()
*₹227*

**1. Best overall: Minimalist Vitamin C 10%** ⭐  
10% Ethyl Ascorbic Acid + 1% Acetyl Glucosamine. Dark spots, uneven tone aur dullness ke liye achha beginner-friendly option; fragrance-free bhi hai. [beminimalist.co](https://beminimalist.co/products/vitamin-c-ethyl-ascorbic-acid-10-acetyl-glucosamine-1?_pos=9&_sid=85e848897&_ss=r&utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**2. Best for pigmentation: Deconstruct 10% Vitamin C + 0.5% Ferulic Acid**  
Liposomal Vitamin C + ferulic acid; brand specifically dark spots, pigmentation aur dullness ke liye position karta hai. [thedeconstruct.in](https://thedeconstruct.in/products/vitamin-c-and-ferulic-acid-serum?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**3. If you want Vitamin C + Niacinamide:** Dot & Key 10% Vitamin C + E + 5% Niacinamide  
Brightening ke saath post-acne marks/oiliness par bhi useful ho sakta hai. [www.dotandkey.com](https://www.dotandkey.com/blogs/skin-care/dermatologist-recommended-face-serums-in-india?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**4. Stronger option: Plum 15% Vitamin C**  
Agar aap pehle se Vitamin C tolerate karte hain, tab 15% consider kar sakte hain. Beginner ke liye main 10% se start karunga.

### Kaise use karein
**Morning:** Cleanser → 2–3 drops Vitamin C → moisturizer → **SPF 50 sunscreen**.  
Sunscreen bahut important hai—warna dark spots ko fade karna difficult rahega. [www.whowhatwear.com](https://www.whowhatwear.com/beauty/skin/best-products-for-hyperpigmentation?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Meri pick:** Agar aap mujhe bina aur details ke ek hi choose karne bolenge, **Minimalist 10% Vitamin C** lo.

Agar aap apni **skin type (oily/dry/combination/sensitive)** aur **budget (₹300/₹500/₹1000)** bata dein, main aapke liye exact 1–2 best options choose kar dunga.

sources.snippet:
This article from Who What Wear UK provides a comprehensive guide to the best skincare products for treating hyperpigmentation, featuring insights from dermatologists and skin experts. Hyperpigmentation, a common skin concern caused by excess melanin, can result from sun exposure, hormonal changes (such as pregnancy-related melasma), inflammation, or acne scarring. The guide emphasizes that the cause of pigmentation determines the best treatment and underlines the importance of daily SPF use as the most critical step in both prevention and treatment.

Recommended ingredients include vitamin C, niacinamide, azelaic acid, tranexamic acid, and retinoids, which can be found in both over-the-counter and prescription products. Experts caution that results typically take 6 to 12 weeks, or even months, and consistency in skincare is essential.

The article highlights 13 carefully selected products, spanning cleansers, serums, moisturizers, and SPFs. Notable mentions include La Roche-Posay Mela B3 Cleanser, Eucerin Pigment Control SPF50+, The Ordinary Azelaic Acid 10%, and Murad Rapid Dark Spot Correcting Serum. Each product is chosen based on expert input, performance, ingredient quality, and user reviews, providing practical options for anyone tackling dark spots and uneven skin tone.
